kitchen-limit.about: How far the kitchen window cover may be open by day: kitchen-morning lowers it to this, Finisci la notte del giudizio opens it to this

studio-limit.about: Where the studio window cover goes against glare on the monitor: Studio pomeriggio feriale lowers it to this at 15:00 Mon-Fri, and the button Abbassa o apri studio toggles between this and fully open, both through [helper] Studio: abbassa. The helpers' conditions are derived from it: above value + 2 counts as more open (lower it), value - 2 to value + 2 as already there (open it fully), below that as more closed (do nothing)

copies.derived: more than value - 3, and less than value + 3

bedroom-privacy.about: Where the button Privacy o apri matrimoniale lowers the master bedroom door cover, for dressing or before sleep. Its helper scenes' conditions are derived from it: above value + 2 counts as more open (lower it), value - 2 to value + 2 as already there (open it fully), below that as more closed (do nothing)

copies.derived: more than value - 3, and less than value + 3

purge-door-delay.about: How long after the windows the door covers close in the purge, so someone outside can come in or stop them
